cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
project(wukong_quickjs C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
add_library(wukong-quickjs SHARED bridge.c vendor/quickjs.c vendor/libregexp.c vendor/libunicode.c vendor/cutils.c vendor/dtoa.c)
target_include_directories(wukong-quickjs PRIVATE vendor)
target_compile_definitions(wukong-quickjs PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE CONFIG_VERSION="2026-06-04")
target_compile_options(wukong-quickjs PRIVATE -Oz -fvisibility=hidden -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -fno-strict-aliasing -fwrapv -flto)
target_link_options(wukong-quickjs PRIVATE -flto -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384 -Wl,-z,common-page-size=16384 -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now)
target_link_libraries(wukong-quickjs m)
